international.title: Consultant doctors in England call off two-day pay strike
international.summary: Action on 25 and 26 November suspended to allow for formal negotations with the government UK politics live – latest updates Senior hospital doctors in England have called off the 48-hour strike they intended to hold later this month after the health secretary agreed to negotiations about their grievances. NHS chiefs, who were worried about how hospitals would cope during the action, welcomed the decision by consultants to “pause” their walkout, which was scheduled for 25 and 26 November.
